name: Lesha Bank LLC
summary: Lesha Bank LLC, an Islamic bank, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial products and solutions to Qatar and internationally. The company operates through Alternative Investments, Private Bank, and Other segments. It provides private wealth management; fixed income money market; investment banking advisory, including mergers and acquisitions, debt advisory/debt capital markets, equity capital markets, and restructuring advisory; and real estate investments services.
